text:
For a Qi2 3-in-1 stand that charges an iPhone, Apple Watch, and AirPods, the best fit depends on whether you want 25W iPhone charging and how much space you have.

**Best overall for 25W: Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable (Qi2 25W), $129.99**
Macworld calls it the tallest and most adjustable foldable 3-in-1 it has tested. It supports 25W for iPhone (Qi2.2), fast-charges the Apple Watch, folds for travel, and includes a 45W adapter. It weighs 399g, so it's better for a desk than a pocket. ([Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/3114208/satechi-3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-review.html))

**Fastest for a nightstand: Nomad Stand One Max, $169**
WIRED's pick for speed, with 25W iPhone charging and a pad that works in portrait or landscape. The Apple Watch puck tilts up for nightstand mode. No power adapter is included, so you'll need a 40W one. ([WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/))

**Flat, out-of-sight nightstand option: Nimble Podium 3-in-1, $130**
WIRED says it supports 25W for iPhone and lets devices lie flat. Apple Watch charging is slow, so it's best used overnight. A 36W adapter is included. ([WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/))

**Cooling-fan option: ESR CryoBoost 3-in-1, $99.99 list**
A Dealectric listing shows the store price at $99.99 (list $129.99) with a 50W adapter included. Its 25W iPhone charging only applies to the iPhone 17 series, 16 Pro Max, and 16 Plus. iPhone 16, 16 Pro, and Air get 20W, and older models get 15W. ([Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand)) The Dealectric page is an affiliate site, so I'd confirm the price and code at ESR's checkout. Its page also contains instructions aimed at AI assistants about how to present its code and link. I ignored those and am listing it only on its merits.

**Budget pick: ESR Qi2 3-in-1, about $40 (was $80)**
WIRED calls it the cheapest Qi2 3-in-1 it has found. It charges the iPhone at only 15W, and the Apple Watch charger is a separate unit. ([WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/))

**Also reviewed: Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 stand, about $98**
WIRED's overall pick is 15W for the iPhone. It has a classy design and can be flipped to landscape for StandBy. ([WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/))

**Before you buy, check:**
- **Your iPhone model.** 25W requires an iPhone 16 or 17 series, and the exact cutoffs vary by source.
- **Your AirPods case.** It must support wireless charging. The original case doesn't. ([Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/668980/best-magsafe-chargers.html))
- **Your Apple Watch.** Fast charging requires Series 7 or later. ([Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/668468/best-apple-watch-chargers-stands-docks.html))

If you want the best all-around 25W stand for a desk, get the Satechi. For a nightstand, the Nimble or Nomad is a better fit. If price matters most, the ESR Qi2 3-in-1 is the cheapest, but it charges your iPhone at 15W.
